description: This file defines an OpenAI provider plugin for a plugin SDK, including model resolution, transport normalization, authentication, and catalog augmentation.

methods.name: shouldUseOpenAIResponsesTransport
methods.description: Determines if the transport should be responses-based based on provider parameters.

methods.name: normalizeOpenAITransport
methods.description: Normalizes the transport method for the OpenAI provider model.

methods.name: resolveOpenAIGpt54ForwardCompatModel
methods.description: Resolves and returns a compatible model configuration for GPT-5.4 and related models.

methods.name: buildSyntheticCatalogEntry
methods.description: Creates a synthetic catalog entry based on a template and entry data.

methods.name: buildOpenAIProvider
methods.description: Constructs and returns the OpenAI provider plugin with configuration, model resolution, and catalog augmentation.
